maintenance_led.reason: Revenue comes from hospital and behavioral health patient care, not repair, servicing or replacement of installed items.

publicly_funded.reason: Acute care and behavioral hospitals are largely paid by Medicare and Medicaid; Prominence Health sells Medicare plans.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows mainly by building and running its own hospitals; the Talkspace deal is a single large acquisition.

mission_critical.reason: Inpatient acute care and psychiatric hospitals deliver regulated, often urgent care; patients and payers can't easily switch providers.

notes: Government share of revenue is likely a majority but the website does not state it.
